Discuss GEO promotion

A format for businesses with their own team

This plan suits a business that has people available to produce content and implement website changes. I lead the GEO strategy, prepare briefs and connect the work to buyer questions. Your team receives website and content requirements, while I check implementation against the agreed scope.

Work begins with intent mapping: what people want to know before buying and how they choose a provider. We use this to build a matrix of at least 50 prompts and select at least 5 AI platforms. The platform mix depends on the audience, market and business objectives.

A detailed audit before promotion →

What monthly work includes

The scope includes website briefs, content briefs, content distribution, link promotion and reputation work. Verifiable business facts remain central: specializations, terms, prices and experience. The material should help a buyer assess whether the offer fits the problem they need to solve.

I identify pages to improve and the relevant materials to connect. For external sources, I consider the publication’s subject and the substance of the article. A detailed account of a buyer’s problem can explain a company’s specialization more effectively than a general service description.

Methodologies behind the work →Documented GEO case studies →

How progress is assessed

Reporting takes place once a month. I compare responses to the agreed questions, brand mention rates and the content of recommendations. The original prompt set is retained so that changes can be checked on a comparable sample. Newly added areas are identified separately.

Initial changes may appear from 1 week, although timing depends on the starting position and implementation. A series of measurements provides a more useful view of progress. Enquiries and payments are checked against separate business data; a mention rate does not by itself establish sales.

Rules for comparable GEO measurements →

Expanding the plan

You can add AI platforms beyond the base 5 and groups of 10 prompts beyond the base 50. Before expanding, we identify the new buyer questions or audiences this will cover. That connects an increase in the monthly price to a defined change in scope.

If your team lacks time to write, the content creation plan is an alternative. A separate financial-guarantee format ties part of the payment to reaching a contractual BMR target. Scope and responsibilities are agreed before the engagement starts.

Additional AI platforms →Additional prompts →Promotion with content creation →BMR targets: +5 / +10 / +15 percentage points over 3 months →
FAQ

Questions about this service

Who writes content on the base plan?+
I prepare content briefs; your team or your chosen writers produce the material. Choose GEO + content if you want GAEO to create it.
Which 5 AI platforms are included?+
The mix is selected for your audience and market. We agree the specific platforms during planning; additional charges begin with the 6th platform.
What will the report contain?+
A monthly account of the work and visibility changes across the agreed matrix. Brand mentions, recommendations, sources and business outcomes are assessed according to what each measure shows.
Can this work for a specialized industry?+
Yes. Prompts, page requirements and external sources are selected for the industry and specialization. The industry section brings together approaches, methodologies and documented cases.
